Charles Bronson denied parole for ninth time

Charles Bronson, a high-profile inmate known as 'Britain's most violent prisoner', has been denied parole for the ninth time. He will remain in jail following the decision. The specific location of his incarceration has been referred to as 'Monster Mansion'.
